svg.title: Power Generation - Screening Inputs
svg.desc: Source screening proposal: temperature >70°C; flow ≥100 m³/h; downstream cascade heat use; small unit around 350 kW. These inputs alone do not establish output or feasibility. Net electricity depends on source/sink temperature, flow, conversion equipment, cooling and parasitic loads.
